ra.title: NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD: Next Generation Scalable Infrastructure for AI Leadership Reference Architecture Featuring NVIDIA DGX B200

system.name: DGX B200
system.psus: 6 x 3.3 kW, 5+1 redundancy (200-240 V AC, C19/C20)

compute_nics.type: ConnectX-7 single-port NDR InfiniBand, presented as 4 x dual-port OSFP (2 network module trays)

system.storage_inband_nics: 2 x BlueField-3 DPU dual-port cards (NIC mode default); RA Fig.4 shows per card one in-band mgmt QSFP + one storage QSFP (single-port QSFP112 400G) i.e. 2 in-band + 2 storage ports per system
system.bmc: 1 GbE RJ45 (RA: OOB port used for BMC; adjacent LAN port unused); Redfish, IPMI, SNMP, KVM, Web UI

su.note_on_ufm_displacement: SU is 32 DGX B200, but a full-SuperPOD node count is 32*SU-1 (31/63/95/127): one DGX system is removed to free compute-fabric leaf ports for the (2) compute UFM appliances. Table 4 footnote: 'This is a 32 node per SU design, however a DGX system must be removed to accommodate for UFM connectivity.'
su.mgmt_racks: RA Fig.3 shows one management rack group (5 rack bays in picture): 16 compute leaves + 16 compute spines + 2 compute UFMs, 2 SN5600 in-band spines + 2 SN5600 in-band leaves, 2 storage UFMs, 2 SN2201 in-band leaves, 7 management nodes, 8 storage leaves + 4 storage spines, 16 SN2201 OOB leaves. Table 7 lists 70 racks total for 4 SU / 127 nodes.

compute_fabric.tech: NVIDIA NDR 400 Gbps InfiniBand, rail-optimized, non-blocking full fat-tree
compute_fabric.oversubscription: 1:1 (non-blocking, balanced fat-tree); per-rail traffic 1 hop across the 32 nodes of an SU. Table 4 (1-4 SU) uses 32*SU-1 nodes with UFM cables counted in 'Compute and UFM'; rows for 8/16/32/64 SU are from Table 3 (which uses 32*SU nodes, no UFM displacement, and conflicts with Table 4 at 4 SU).

storage_fabric.tech: InfiniBand (QM9700) or optional Ethernet/RoCE (Spectrum-X SN5600 800GbE); independent of compute fabric
storage_fabric.switch_model: NVIDIA MQM9700-NS2F (QM9700) IB; NVIDIA SN5600 for Ethernet option
storage_fabric.counts: Table 7 (4 SU): 16 QM9700 storage fabric switches; Fig.3 (4 SU mgmt rack): 8 storage leaves + 4 storage spines (=12) + 2 storage UFM
storage_fabric.ratio: Storage devices 1:1 port:uplink; DGX connections oversubscribed ~4:3

inband.counts: Table 7 (4 SU): 4 x SN5600 + 2 x SN2201 in-band; Fig.3: 2 SN5600 spines + 2 SN5600 leaves + 2 SN2201 in-band leaves
inband.speed: 200 Gbps bonded for compute and management nodes (DGX ports are 400G QSFP112; 254 QSFP112 in-band transceivers for 127 nodes)

oob.switch_model: NVIDIA SN2201 (48 x 1GbE RJ45, 4 x 100G uplink), Cumulus Linux
oob.counts: Table 7 (4 SU): 17 SN2201 OOB; Fig.3 shows 16 SN2201 OOB leaves

mgmt_plane.ufm: NVIDIA UFM Appliance Enterprise Edition; 4 for 4 SU (2 compute + 2 storage per Fig.3)
mgmt_plane.bcm_or_mgmt_nodes: 7 management servers (2x Intel x86 24c+, 384 GB RAM, 2x480GB OS RAID1, 7.68TB NVMe, 4x NDR VPI ports, TPM); NVIDIA Base Command Manager manages all deployments; Mission Control includes BCM and Run:ai
mgmt_plane.other: Run:ai, NGC, NVIDIA AI Enterprise, Magnum IO, Slurm; multitenancy not supported, only multi-team via BCM. Rack PDUs: Raritan PX3-5878I2R-P1Q2R1A15D5 (192) and PX3-5747V-V2 (12).

major_components_table.model: Intel x86 2x24c+, 384GB RAM, 2x480GB RAID1, NVMe 7.68TB raw, 4x NDR VPI, TPM

power_cooling.rack_power_kw_options: 2 systems/rack: 28.6 kW (42U min, 52U recommended, 2x 380V 3ph 32A); 4 systems/rack: 57.2 kW (52U, 2x 415V 3ph 60A) in specialised high-density sites. SU = 458 kW (32 systems). RA figure: 'power consumption per rack exceeds 25 kW'.
power_cooling.preferred_supply: N provisioning with 2 discrete circuits/PDUs from two UPS sources, each circuit sized for 50% of rack peak; dual-interleaved, in-rack STS not recommended; '6 to make 5' optimal for HA
power_cooling.airflow_or_liquid_notes: Air-cooled only. Est. 150 CFM/kW: 4290 CFM (2-sys rack), 8580 CFM (4-sys rack); per-system airflow 1,550 CFM, 48,794 BTU/hr. Operating 10-35C (UG) / 5-30C (DC deck). Rear-door HX and in-row coolers not typically suitable.

ambiguities: Node count: Table 3 says 4 SU = 128 nodes / 1024 GPUs (and text 'focused on 4 SU units with 128 DGX nodes'), Table 4/Fig.5/Table 7 say 127 nodes / 1016 GPUs (UFM displaces one system). Both cable counts (1024 leaf-spine) agree; node-leaf differs (1024 vs 1020).
Table 3 rows 2 SU = 64 nodes vs Table 4 = 63 nodes; Table 3 has no 1 SU or 3 SU row and gives no core for <=8 SU (dash).
Table 4 column headings flatten to 'Compute and UFM' (= node-leaf cables incl. 4 UFM ports) and 'Spine-Leaf' (= leaf-spine); mapped accordingly. 252 = 31*8+4 confirms.

Storage switch count: Table 7 says 16 QM9700 storage switches; Fig.3 shows 8 storage leaves + 4 storage spines = 12. OOB SN2201: Table 7 = 17, Fig.3 = 16. In-band SN5600: Table 7 = 4, Fig.3 = 2 spines + 2 leaves (consistent).
Management rack count not stated; Fig.3 shows 5 rack bays, Table 7 total 70 racks (64 compute + 6 other implied, not stated).
System weight: 142.4 kg (user guide, max) vs '>130 kg' (DC best-practices deck, 'estimated'). Operating temp: 10-35C (UG) vs 5-30C (DC deck).

Rack power: RA says per-rack 'exceeds 25 kW' (example); 28.6 kW (2 systems) and 57.2 kW (4 systems) come from the separate DC best-practices deck (Steven Hambruch), marked NVIDIA CONFIDENTIAL in footer though publicly hosted; it gives 'up to 32 DGX B200 for 458 kW per SU' (32x14.3).
Racks per SU (16) is inferred from Fig.2 (16 racks, 2 DGX each), not stated in text. Rack U-height 48U in figure/52U recommended in DC deck.
QM9700 port count (64 x 400G via 32 OSFP cages) is NOT stated in the RA; 64 used from vendor knowledge. The RA states SN5600 is 64 OSFP 800G.
NIC/port counts for storage and in-band (2 + 2 per system) are inferred from Fig.4 and 254 QSFP112 transceiver counts (127 x 2), not stated as a sentence.
Text says storage fabric ports oversubscribed ~4:3 for DGX side, but no per-leaf port split given. Storage perf table has only Standard/Enhanced; mapped to good/better, best=null.

RA web page 'Last updated on Sep 02, 2026' but document header still V08 2025-04-24. RA text also mentions 'the LAN port next to BMC is not used'.
